svg.title: WESTSIDE WATCH — Engraved night / horizon / light source
svg.desc: Source-directed, manually programmed editorial burin field for the original v5.3 Morning Star at approximately 77 percent across the page. Four deliberately unequal curvilinear bands, broken cross-hatches and hand-cut stipple; open star centre and protected masthead area. Engraved strokes are optically compensated for 320–1648px responsive square folios; not a radial laser grid or all-over ornament.
